description: Schemas treaty holds under the $id their owner publishes them at, not their treaty address. Checked by schemas/treaty/published-ids.v1.json and scripts/schema-ids.test.ts.

schemas.why: SuperWitness publishes the run-report schema at its docs site and embeds it in its server; sources vendor it by that address. Treaty holds the same bytes (sha256 b2444841…) so the runs contract can name it as POST /v1/runs's body (phase 4, ruling 3).
